content_sections.heading: HPPSC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 65/10-2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download HPPSC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: At least 2nd class M.Sc. in Forensic Science (with specialization/ dissertation work/ course work/ project work in the field of Chemical Sciences) OR At least 2nd class M.Sc. in Chemistry/ Bio-Chemistry/ Pharmacy/ M.S.(Pharm.)/ M. Pharm. degree from a recognized University. Experience: Minimum three (03) years of post-qualification experience in Research, Training and Analytical Work within the specified subjects. Age limit: 18 to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/WFF/Persons with disabilities of Himachal Pradesh 5 years, HP Govt employees and Ex-Servicemen of HP As per Government instructions Other conditions: Recruitment governed by Department of Personnel notification dated 19th July, 2025. Reservation benefits only for bonafide residents of Himachal Pradesh. Desirable: Ph.D. Degree in one of the relevant subjects. Knowledge of customs, manners and dialects of Himachal Pradesh and suitability for engagement in peculiar conditions.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for HPPSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates dismissed from previous Govt/Semi Govt service. Candidates convicted of offences involving moral turpitude. Un-discharged insolvents.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engagement governed as per scheme for job trainees on fixed amount vide DoP notification dated 19th July, 2025

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI / online digital mode. Last date to pay the fee: 3 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will HPPSC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Objective Type Screening Test / Descriptive Subject Aptitude Test Personality Test Paper-I: Computer Based Test or Offline Screening Test with 100 objective type MCQs Paper-II: Descriptive Subject Aptitude Test of 120 marks Personality Test of 30 marks

content_sections.heading: HPPSC Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Negative marking of 0.25 marks for wrong answers, multiple answers, or blank answers without option E. Minimum pass marks in Subject Aptitude Test is 45% for General and 40% for reserved categories.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HPPSC Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit official website of HPPSC at http://www.hppsc.hp.gov.in/hppsc. Click on Apply Online and then One Time Registration (OTR) for Examinations. Register and create profile or log in. Select the post and upload required documents. Give undertaking regarding document readability and submit application. Send it on or before 3 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Entry into the examination venue shall be closed 30 minutes before commencement.
